item.title: Show HN: StoneBuild – a build tool in Go for your projects in any languages
item.summary: Hi, HN! Personally, I find Makefile syntax particularly cumbersome, and I think the output lacks style. That’s exactly how StoneBuild—a build tool—came about. The tool is currently in the pre-release stage, and I’m working to find and fix bugs as often as possible. I’d love to hear your feedback!
